item.title: A message from Mr. D'Alessio:
item.description: Attention high school students, auditions for “Footloose” the musical are taking place next week on Wednesday and Thursday at lunch in Rm.209.

item.title: A message from Mr. Warner:
item.description: Congratulations to the junior girls' basketball team who went 5 - 0 in league play yesterday at RHS. Even though they were missing a few players, they wound up beating RHS 49 - 19 by getting timely scoring and playing tight defense; especially in the second half. Next up in VCI next week at STA. Great job girls!
